$comment: Configuration for the API surface parity tests (ApiSurfaceParityTests, EnumValueParityTests, ElementMethodInvocationTests). Per-component 'ignoredEnumValues' maps a CEM attribute to the enum members whose ToHtmlValue() output deliberately falls outside the attribute's string-literal union (typically library-wide shared enums, or a 'None' member for which the attribute is omitted); each attribute entry needs an 'ignoreReasons' entry keyed 'ignoredEnumValues:<tag>:<attribute>', and stale entries fail EnumValueParityTests. The reverse direction (every union literal emitted by some enum member) is allowlisted per component in 'unreachableUnionValues' (attribute -> literals, reason key 'unreachableUnionValues:<tag>:<attribute>') and per enum type in the top-level 'unreachableEnumUnionValues' (enum name -> { literals, attributes: ['<tag>:<attribute>', ...] }, reason key 'unreachableEnumUnionValues:<enum>'; the exemption applies only to the listed attributes, each of which must still need every literal); attribute types are read alias-resolved ('resolvedType' of the surface); a plain-string attribute read as a space-separated token list is declared per component in 'tokenListAttributes' (attribute -> tokens, reason key 'tokenListAttributes:<tag>:<attribute>'), and an enum parameter bound to an attribute whose type resolves to no literal union fails unless listed in per-component 'unresolvedEnumAttributes' (reason key 'unresolvedEnumAttributes:<tag>:<attribute>'); bool parameters deliberately bound to a string-literal union go into per-component 'ignoredBoolUnionAttributes' (reason key 'ignoredBoolUnionAttributes:<tag>:<attribute>'); The render-based event checks (EventCallbackBindingParityTests, EventBindingRegistrationTests) use: top-level 'nativeDomEvents' (native DOM event -> EventCallback name, for events the CEM does not list; reason key 'nativeDomEvents:<event>'), per-component 'derivedEventCallbacks' (callback -> the event whose handler raises it; reason key 'derivedEventCallbacks:<tag>:<callback>'), 'unboundEventCallbacks' (inherited callbacks deliberately left unbound; reason key 'unboundEventCallbacks:<tag>:<callback>'), 'undeclaredBoundEvents' (bound events the element's CEM entry does not declare; reason key 'undeclaredBoundEvents:<tag>:<event>') 'cemOnlyEvents' (CEM events neither the @event JSDoc nor dist\events declares, which no check relies on; reason key 'cemOnlyEvents:<tag>:<event>') and 'sourceVerifiedEvents' (CEM events the @event JSDoc omits but the compiled source was verified to dispatch - re-verify every upgrade; reason key 'sourceVerifiedEvents:<tag>:<event>'); both checked by CemEventCorroborationTests. Stale entries in every list fail. 'enabled' is flipped to true by the wa-upgrade process once expected-api-surface.json matches the version being implemented. Overrides document intentional naming deviations of the Blazor wrappers - typically idiomatic .NET PascalCase word splits (e.g. maxlength -> MaxLength, autofocus -> AutoFocus) that differ from mechanical kebab-case conversion; ignores document intentional omissions (each ignore should carry a reason in 'ignoreReasons'). 'nativeElementMethods' lists DOM methods valid on any element; per-component 'extraElementMethods' allowlists element methods that exist in the Web Awesome source but are not CEM-documented - these MUST be re-verified against the target version's source on every upgrade (the CEM diff cannot see them).

ignoreReasons.title: native HTML attribute, passed through via AdditionalAttributes
ignoreReasons.did-ssr: internal SSR hydration marker set by Web Awesome server-side rendering (added to every component's base element in WA 3.3.0); not a consumer-authorable attribute
ignoreReasons.dir: native HTML global attribute, passed through via AdditionalAttributes (added to every component's base element in WA 3.3.0)
ignoreReasons.lang: native HTML global attribute, passed through via AdditionalAttributes (added to every component's base element in WA 3.3.0)
ignoreReasons.role: native ARIA global HTML attribute; WA 3.8.0 reflects an internal default role onto the host of several components (wa-rating='slider', wa-tab='tab', wa-tab-panel='tabpanel', wa-tree='tree', wa-tree-item='treeitem') as part of its own accessibility management - not a consumer-authorable parameter, passed through via AdditionalAttributes when overridden
ignoreReasons.tabindex: native HTML global attribute; WA 3.8.0 reflects a managed tabindex onto wa-tree (0) and wa-tree-item (-1) to implement roving-tabindex keyboard navigation - not a consumer-authorable parameter, passed through via AdditionalAttributes when overridden
ignoreReasons.change: native change event folded into Blazor two-way binding (ValueChanged / @bind-Value)
ignoreReasons.name: form-control name is handled by Blazor InputBase form integration (NameAttributeValue / EditContext), not a discrete parameter
ignoreReasons.checked: checkbox checked state is the two-way-bound Value on WaInputBase<bool>
ignoreReasons.custom-error: the manually-set custom validity message (WA 3.3.0 form-associated validation) is managed imperatively through IFormValidation.SetCustomValidityAsync / ResetValidityAsync (JS interop), not an authorable attribute
ignoreReasons.formStateRestoreCallback: form-associated custom element (FACE) lifecycle callback the browser invokes to restore or autofill element state (WA 3.3.0); not consumer-facing and not marshalable from Blazor
ignoreReasons.plugins: Chart.js plugin registration is a JS-only array (typed never[] in the WA source, supplied via the chart's JSON <script> config slot); not an authorable HTML attribute
ignoreReasons.visiblePixelsInViewport: wa-page internal scroll-gap layout helper (takes a live HTMLElement arg; its own doc comment cites a StackOverflow scroll-fill fix) - not a consumer-facing API and not marshalable from Blazor
ignoreReasons.timeupdate: wa-video native media event; exposed as the natural-PascalCase EventCallback OnTimeUpdate (mechanical conversion would yield 'OnTimeupdate'), mapped via eventOverrides
ignoreReasons.volumechange: wa-video native media event; exposed as the natural-PascalCase EventCallback OnVolumeChange (mechanical conversion would yield 'OnVolumechange'), mapped via eventOverrides
ignoreReasons.loadedmetadata: wa-video native media event; exposed as the natural-PascalCase EventCallback OnLoadedMetadata (mechanical conversion would yield 'OnLoadedmetadata'), mapped via eventOverrides
ignoreReasons.getVideoElement: wa-video method returning the live native HTMLVideoElement; a DOM node, not marshalable across Blazor JS interop, so not exposed as a wrapper method
ignoreReasons.maxlength: exposed as MaxLength on WaInputBase (idiomatic .NET casing); mapped via attributeOverrides
ignoreReasons.minlength: exposed as MinLength on WaInputBase (idiomatic .NET casing); mapped via attributeOverrides
ignoreReasons.beforeinput: wa-number-input's cancelable before-value-change event (added in WA 3.6.0); exposed as the natural-PascalCase EventCallback OnBeforeInput (mechanical conversion would yield 'OnBeforeinput'), mapped via eventOverrides
ignoreReasons.getSymbol: function-valued property (custom symbol renderer callback), not an authorable HTML attribute
ignoreReasons.getMarked: static class method (WaMarkdown.getMarked() in markdown.d.ts) returning the shared Marked parser instance - a non-marshalable JS object, not a per-element instance method
ignoreReasons.updateAll: static class method (WaMarkdown.updateAll() in markdown.d.ts) that re-renders all connected wa-markdown instances after the shared Marked config changes - class-level, not a per-element instance method addressable via ElementReference interop

ignoreReasons.cemOnlyEvents:wa-data-grid:request: CEM extraction artifact of wa-data-grid, not a real event: it carries the same WaDataRequestEvent type as wa-data-request, and neither dist\events\events.d.ts (the canonical event-class export list) nor the component's own @event JSDoc block declares a bare 'request' - the compiled source only ever dispatches wa-data-request, which is bound as OnDataRequest
ignoreReasons.wa-cell-contextmenu: wa-data-grid cell context-menu event; exposed as the natural-PascalCase EventCallback OnCellContextMenu (mechanical conversion would yield 'OnCellContextmenu'), mapped via eventOverrides
ignoreReasons.getColumnFacets: wa-data-grid method returning { uniqueValues: Map<...>, minMax }; a JS Map serializes to an empty object over JSON interop, silently losing every value, so no faithful wrapper method can be offered
ignoreReasons.handleColumnsChange: internal wa-data-grid reactive-property watcher invoked by the element's own update cycle, not consumer API
ignoreReasons.handlePageChange: internal wa-data-grid reactive-property watcher invoked by the element's own update cycle, not consumer API
ignoreReasons.handleSearchTermChange: internal wa-data-grid reactive-property watcher invoked by the element's own update cycle, not consumer API
ignoreReasons.autosubmit: exposed as AutoSubmit on WaOtpInput (natural PascalCase, matching the existing autofocus -> AutoFocus convention); mapped via attributeOverrides
ignoreReasons.hrefTemplate: wa-pagination's href-template also accepts a JS function (page: number) => string; only the string-template form is exposed as WaPagination.HrefTemplate, because a JS function cannot cross the Blazor interop boundary - the attribute name itself needs no override
ignoreReasons.currentSlide: read-only JS state property of wa-carousel, not an authorable HTML attribute
ignoreReasons.slides: read-only JS collection property of wa-carousel, not an authorable HTML attribute
ignoreReasons.submenuOpen: read-only JS state property of wa-dropdown-item, not an authorable HTML attribute
ignoreReasons.extraElementMethods:stopObserver/startOb: observer control methods, browser-verified on the live WA 3.0.0 elements (2026-07-19) after the disconnect/reconnect rename incident and source-re-verified against WA 3.1.0 (2026-07-22), WA 3.2.0 (2026-07-23), WA 3.2.1 (2026-07-23), WA 3.3.0 (2026-07-23), WA 3.3.1 (2026-07-23), WA 3.4.0 (2026-07-23), WA 3.5.0 (2026-07-23), WA 3.6.0 (2026-07-24), WA 3.7.0 (2026-07-24), WA 3.8.0 (2026-07-24), WA 3.9.0 (2026-07-24), WA 3.10.0 (2026-07-24), WA 3.11.0 (2026-07-30) and WA 3.12.0 (2026-09-24), still present as private methods in mutation-observer.d.ts/resize-observer.d.ts; the CEM reports empty methods for both observers, so renames here are invisible to the upgrade diff - re-verify each upgrade
ignoreReasons.extraElementMethods:update: wa-relative-time refresh method, browser-verified on the live WA 3.0.0 element (2026-07-19) and source-re-verified against WA 3.1.0 (2026-07-22), WA 3.2.0 (2026-07-23), WA 3.2.1 (2026-07-23), WA 3.3.0 (2026-07-23), WA 3.3.1 (2026-07-23), WA 3.4.0 (2026-07-23), WA 3.5.0 (2026-07-23), WA 3.6.0 (2026-07-24), WA 3.7.0 (2026-07-24), WA 3.8.0 (2026-07-24), WA 3.9.0 (2026-07-24), WA 3.10.0 (2026-07-24), WA 3.11.0 (2026-07-30) and WA 3.12.0 (2026-09-24, the Lit ReactiveElement lifecycle update() inherited via WebAwesomeElement - 'WebAwesomeElement extends LitElement' reconfirmed in internal\webawesome-element.d.ts, hence absent from the component .d.ts: relative-time.d.ts declares only disconnectedCallback, willUpdate and render), not CEM-documented
ignoreReasons.ignoredEnumValues:wa-popup:auto-size: WaAutoSize.None ('') is the non-nullable parameter's 'off' state; WaPopup omits the auto-size attribute entirely when AutoSize == None, so the empty string is never emitted
ignoreReasons.ignoredEnumValues:wa-popup:sync: WaSync.None ('') is the non-nullable parameter's 'off' state; WaPopup omits the sync attribute entirely when Sync == None, so the empty string is never emitted
ignoreReasons.tokenListAttributes:wa-tooltip:trigger: wa-tooltip's trigger is typed string, but the element reads it as a space-separated token list: the 3.12.0 tooltip.d.ts JSDoc lists click, hover, focus and manual ('multiple options can be passed by separating them with a space'), and the compiled tooltip chunk tests exactly those four via hasTrigger("click"|"hover"|"focus"|"manual"), which splits the attribute on spaces - re-verify every upgrade
ignoreReasons.unresolvedEnumAttributes:wa-animation:ea: wa-animation's easing is typed string because it takes any CSS <easing-function> (the JSDoc cites cubic-bezier(...)); WaAnimationEasing offers the CSS easing keywords linear, ease, ease-in, ease-out and ease-in-out, which the CSS Easing Functions spec defines, so no CEM union exists to check them against
ignoreReasons.unreachableEnumUnionValues:WaChartLegend: 'center' comes from Chart.js' shared LayoutPosition type (a scale position); the Chart.js 4 legend documents only top, left, bottom, right and chartArea, so WaChartLegendPosition deliberately has no Center member
ignoreReasons.unreachableEnumUnionValues:WaSize: the long size spellings 'small'/'medium'/'large' are deprecated in WA 3.12.0 ('will be removed in the next major version'); WaSize.Small/Medium/Large emit the equivalent short forms 's'/'m'/'l' since 3.12.0, so the deprecated literals are intentionally unreachable
ignoreReasons.unreachableUnionValues:wa-badge:attentio: 'none' is the WA default (no animation); it is reached by leaving the nullable WaBadge.Attention unset, which omits the attribute, so WaAttention has no None member
ignoreReasons.nativeDomEvents:blur: native blur, dispatched by the browser on any focusable host (composed, retargeted from a focused shadow descendant) and read by Blazor's built-in focus reader; several focusable elements (wa-tab, wa-rating) do not list it in their CEM entry
ignoreReasons.nativeDomEvents:click: native click, dispatched by the browser on any element (composed, bubbling out of the shadow tree); Web Awesome documents no click event for wa-button, wa-tab or wa-breadcrumb-item because it is not theirs to dispatch
ignoreReasons.nativeDomEvents:focus: native focus, dispatched by the browser on any focusable host (composed, retargeted from a focused shadow descendant) and read by Blazor's built-in focus reader; several focusable elements (wa-tab, wa-rating) do not list it in their CEM entry
ignoreReasons.nativeDomEvents:keydown: native keyboard event, dispatched by the browser on the focused element and composed out of the shadow tree, so the host of every focusable form control receives it; Web Awesome documents no keyboard events
ignoreReasons.nativeDomEvents:keypress: native keyboard event, dispatched by the browser on the focused element and composed out of the shadow tree, so the host of every focusable form control receives it; Web Awesome documents no keyboard events
ignoreReasons.nativeDomEvents:keyup: native keyboard event, dispatched by the browser on the focused element and composed out of the shadow tree, so the host of every focusable form control receives it; Web Awesome documents no keyboard events
ignoreReasons.derivedEventCallbacks:wa-checkbox:OnChec: reports the checked state read back from the element after the native change event; raised by the wrapper's change handler (the value binding), which is always bound
ignoreReasons.derivedEventCallbacks:wa-switch:OnChecke: reports the checked state read back from the element after the native change event; raised by the wrapper's change handler (the value binding), which is always bound
ignoreReasons.derivedEventCallbacks:wa-radio-group:OnV: reports the new value after the native change event; raised by the wrapper's change handler (the value binding), which is always bound
ignoreReasons.derivedEventCallbacks:wa-slider:OnValueC: WaSlider: reports the new single value after the change event; raised by the numericchange handler (the value binding), which is always bound
ignoreReasons.derivedEventCallbacks:wa-slider:OnMinVal: WaRange (renders wa-slider): reports the new range minimum after the change event; raised by the range-mode numericchange handler
ignoreReasons.derivedEventCallbacks:wa-slider:OnMaxVal: WaRange (renders wa-slider): reports the new range maximum after the change event; raised by the range-mode numericchange handler
ignoreReasons.derivedEventCallbacks:wa-tab-group:OnTab: kept alias of OnTabShow: Web Awesome 3 has no wa-tab-change event, so the wrapper raises OnTabChange from the same wa-tab-show handler as OnTabShow
ignoreReasons.unboundEventCallbacks:wa-rating:OnInput: OnInput is inherited from WaInputBase; wa-rating dispatches no input event (the 3.12.0 source dispatches only change and wa-hover, and neither the @event JSDoc nor the CEM lists input), so the wrapper deliberately binds nothing for it
ignoreReasons.unreachableUnionValues:wa-data-grid:sele: '' is the bare-attribute form of selectable, which WA documents as meaning 'multiple'; WaDataGridSelectable.Multiple emits 'multiple' explicitly, so the empty literal adds no reachable behavior
